correctness.rationale: For all nonzero c∈C⁶ and exactly the fixed six integer frequencies, Haar Parseval gives a finite cubic-convolution polynomial. At u, 216 ordered triples and square multiplicity 2040 give normalized sixth moment 85/9. Exact polynomial second variation with denominator cube produces the rational matrices displayed in RESULT.md; checker.py reconstructs every entry and their rational eigenspace multiplicities from the 216 integer triples. The only tangent zero directions are common phase and both translations; normal eigenvalues are -15,-27,-77/3,-68/3,-65/3 with respective multiplicities 1,2,1,2,2. Uniform smooth Taylor expansion near compact phase-and-translation orbit shows strict local maximality and gap coefficient 15, attained infinitesimally along the specified phase-normal vector. No global inequality is inferred from this local certificate.

value.rationale: The centrally symmetric six-mode root hexagon is a natural smallest lattice spectral shell relevant to two-dimensional wave interference. Complete normal-space stability for arbitrary complex coefficients, including exact nontrivial amplitude and phase bands and absence of spurious zero modes, is not a textbook substitution of a generic theorem and is not fixed by symmetry alone. The sharp infinitesimal distance deficit 15 identifies the weakest deformation, a reusable exact local concentration benchmark even without global norm optimization.
